page.overview:
What is Macuahuitl?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macuahuitl Macuahuitl] is an Ancient Aztec weapon that is used by Kotal Kahn. The name is derived from the [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahuatl Nahuatl language] and means "hand-wood".

In Mortal Kombat X, the macuahuitl is only available in Kotal Kahn's War God Variation, which gives him crushing attacks all based on the use of his macuahuitl. His Osh-Tekk warriors use one during Kung Jin's Chapter in the Story Mode to execute a poor and starving Outworlder, but is saved by Kung Jin before his execution.

In Mortal Kombat 11, it returns as Kotal Kahn's primary weapon and is used regardless of variation. The weapon is also a customizable gear item in the game's Kustomization.
